description: Generate a styled Markdown or HTML report for bulk analysis: compare multiple domains, analyse a list of URLs, or crawl a sitemap. Returns a self-contained report with rankings, category breakdowns, and per-domain/page recommendations. Provide exactly one of: domains, urls, sitemap_url, or analysis_results. You can pass pre-computed results from compare_domains, analyze_urls, or analyze_sitemap (with output_format='json') to avoid re-crawling.

analysis_results.description: Pre-computed analysis results from compare_domains, analyze_urls, or analyze_sitemap (with output_format='json'). If provided, no crawling will be performed. The type of report generated depends on the structure of the results.

domains.description: Compare 2-50 domains. E.g. ["example.com", "competitor.com"]. Do not include https://. For more than 50, run multiple times.

format.description: Report format. "markdown" = Markdown report, "html" = standalone styled HTML page.

max_pages.description: For domain comparison: max pages to crawl per domain (default 10). Ignored for urls/sitemap/analysis_results.

max_urls.description: For sitemap mode: max URLs to analyse from the sitemap. Defaults to all. Ignored if analysis_results provided.

rate_limit.description: Max requests/second per domain for URL/sitemap modes. Defaults to 5. Ignored if analysis_results provided.

render_mode.description: How to fetch HTML. "static" (default), "auto" (static with Chrome fallback on bot-block), or "chrome" (always render via local headless Chrome). Ignored if analysis_results provided.

urls.description: Analyse specific URLs. E.g. ["https://example.com/about", "https://example.com/pricing"]. Include https://.

name: export_bulk_report
